title: Gear-Driven Shadow Forge
description: A mechanical workshop where interlocking gears drive a shadow-casting light rig above a ShadowmappableMesh stage. The user adjusts gear ratios, light positions, and mesh transformations while conserving a fixed total 'energy budget' distributed across rotation speed, light intensity, and shadow resolution. Full undo/redo tracks every parameter change.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a Gear-Driven Shadow Forge. Load gears.glb and ShadowmappableMesh.glb via GLTFLoader. Place the ShadowmappableMesh at the center as a 'stage floor' receiving shadows. Position the gears model above-left, visually connected to a directional light rig. Setup: PerspectiveCamera at (5,6,8) looking at origin. Add a DirectionalLight with shadow mapping enabled (2048x2048 shadow map), an AmbientLight(0x334455,0.3), and a ground plane. Enable OrbitControls. Core mechanic — Energy Conservation: maintain a total energy budget of 100 units split among three coupled parameters: gearSpeed (controls gear animation rpm, 0-60), lightIntensity (DirectionalLight intensity, 0-3), and shadowQuality (shadow map size 512/1024/2048/4096 mapped to cost 10/25/50/80). Changing one parameter auto-reduces others proportionally to keep total at 100. UI Panel: create an HTML overlay with three sliders for gearSpeed, lightIntensity, shadowQuality. Display current energy allocation as colored bars. Add Undo and Redo buttons. Interactions (10-14 steps): 1) drag gearSpeed slider — gears spin faster, other values rebalance. 2) adjust lightIntensity — shadows get brighter/dimmer. 3) change shadowQuality — shadow map resolution updates live. 4) click on the ShadowmappableMesh to cycle through 3 transform presets (flat, tilted 30°, wave-displaced via vertex shader). 5) drag the directional light position around a circular track by clicking+dragging a visible light-handle sphere. 6) double-click a gear to toggle its rotation direction. 7-8) use Undo/Redo to revert any parameter or transform change. 9) right-click the stage mesh to toggle wireframe overlay. 10) press 'R' to reset all to defaults. Animate gears each frame: rotate gear children around Y-axis at gearSpeed rpm. Store every state change in a history stack (max 50 entries) for undo/redo. Show a real-time shadow preview indicator showing shadow map utilization percentage. All interactions must reflect the conservation constraint visually and numerically.
